entities.name: Gustavo Magariños
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Gustavo Magariños Morales de los Rios was a Uruguayan basketball player and diplomat. He competed in the men's tournament at the 1948 Summer Olympics. After retiring as a basketball player, he developed a career as a diplomat. He was Uruguayan ambassador to Argentina between 1975 and 1978, during the military dictatorships of both countries.

entities.summary: Gustavo Magariños Morales de los Rios was a Uruguayan basketball player and diplomat. He competed in the men's tournament at the 1948 Summer Olympics. After retiring as a basketball player, he developed a career as a diplomat. He was Uruguayan ambassador to Argentina between 1975 and 1978, during the military dictatorships of both countries.
